title: A snapshot digest
heading: Round 1: A Run Repeats Only Relative to Everything It Read
cases: the same content written with its keys in another order gives the same digest, and a $1k change gives another
adding a project changes the digest
the projects listed in another order give the same digest
the must-do ids listed in another order give the same digest
two fresh processes with different string-hash seeds compute the same digest
the digest is taken over exactly the canonical form the statement specifies
